verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a REST API for managing sites, deploys, DNS "and more" programmatically, plus an official CLI and a way to connect AI assistants to the account, so there is a real programmatic surface. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage map, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, API coverage of team access/secrets, analytics, security and collaboration features, and independent hands-on confirmation of API completeness.
